run_convert_aria_weights_to_hf: run the CLI script to convert Aria model weights from original format to Hugging Face format
load_original_state_dict: load the original state dict from a Hugging Face Hub model repository containing safetensors files
convert_state_dict_to_hf: convert an original Aria state dict to Hugging Face compatible key naming with modified mappings
convert_aria_llama_to_hf: convert Aria LLaMA model weights to Hugging Face format and push the model and processor to the hub
build_convert_aria_pipeline: build a conversion pipeline that loads original Aria weights, remaps keys, and publishes the converted model to the Hugging Face Hub
